method: OpenAI built-in image_gen, product-mockup generation; WebP encoding retains original alpha

cloth.brief: Neutral silver-grey photorealistic front and back blank football jerseys above a horizontal knitted supporter scarf, floating on genuine transparent background; real seams, hollow neck, folds, fine weave. No text or logos.

stadium.brief: Monochrome cinematic night stadium from low on the pitch; roof floodlights and volumetric mist at edges, dark negative space above for personalized club artwork. No text, clubs or players.

application: Original league logos and personal lettering are applied separately in code. Three independently editable colours preserve the generated material luminance.
